title: tgrep
brief: Microsoft's fast codebase search tool with client/server indexing support for large repositories, shared as 7–50x faster than ripgrep and ugrep.
caveat: the 7–50x speedup claim is poster-reported and unverified.
details: An X post from Frank (jedisct1) about Microsoft's tgrep — grep for large codebases with client/server support, claimed 7–50x faster than ripgrep and ugrep. The link is the announcement; the speedup claim is the poster's. (x.com is not directly fetchable from this environment; the breakdown reflects the announcement's subject as curated.)
